g.text: Three independent workstreams / One coordinated engineering workflow
FIFO + dependencies / Agent 01 assigns tasks & owns shared records
Task records / Code documentation / ADRs when needed / Draw.io + SVG + PDF / Tests & evidence / Handoffs
Coordination rules: exclusive task ownership / no shared-file edits without handoff / no autonomous merges
